setting.label: account selection policy
setting.help: Chooses eligible sibling accounts within the same provider and credential tier. A compatible, unexpired lease from a successful request takes priority for every policy; it does not guarantee a cache hit. Reset soonest prefers the nearest weekly refill, then the five-hour refill within one-minute ties. An explicit policy overrides the legacy usage-aware account pick setting.

choices.label: Reset soonest
choices.description: Prefer the nearest included-plan reset; spread ties and unknown reports deterministically. Default for new configurations.

choices.label: Most headroom
choices.description: Prefer cached remaining quota, spreading accounts within ten percentage points of the best.

choices.label: Fair spread
choices.description: Use a stable session-based spread instead of ranking cached resets or remaining quota.
